label: Dsr system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a defense-associated sirtuin locus whose SIR2-domain effector can deplete NAD+ during bacteriophage defense and is modeled by DefenseFinder as Dsr subtypes.
observations: Dsr branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual dsr genes, Dsr proteins, generic sirtuins or SIR2 domains, Thoeris Sir2 domains, prokaryotic Argonaute-associated Sir2 proteins, metabolic dissimilatory sulfite reductase DsrAB systems, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Dsr component, and other phage defense systems.
